cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add='''## Riset kandidat BARU — 17 Nov (HN, GitHub, openuncensored)
Metode: HN Algolia (created_at 7 hari), GitHub Search API (created:>2026-11-10),
penelusuran provider dari `api.openuncensored.com/v1/models`.
### PETA PROVIDER UNCSENSORED (dari openuncensored API)
openuncensored.com = agregator 61 model uncensored (bukan gratis, bayar $10+).
Yang penting: daftar provider di baliknya.
| Provider | Model uncensored |
|---|---|
| nanogpt | 42 |
| venice | 14 |
| openrouter | 12 |
| heabsy | 10 |
| abliteration-ai | 3 |
| refuseless | 3 |
| uncensuredai | 3 |
| redpill | 2 |
| lebrel | 1 |
### LEBREL (lebrel.ai) — KANDIDAT TERBAIK ✅ BARU
```
model   : lebrel/deepseek-v4.1-flash-uncensored
base url: https://api.lebrel.ai/v1        (401 tanpa key = endpoint nyata)
daftar  : email via BetterAuth /sign-up/email  (TANPA nomor HP)
```
- **Gratis 7 hari** dengan **$100 kredit API** (plan 1x)
- **Gratis 4 jam/hari** edisi uncensored, 16:00-20:00 Madrid = **22:00-02:00 WIB**
- Harga setelah trial: $17/bln (termasuk $100 API)
- Harga token: input $0.33/1M, output $1.32/1M, cached $0.01/1M
- Konteks 1M token, TEE terenkripsi, receipt ditandatangani + tercatat di Solana
- Airdrop LBRL untuk pemakaian berbayar
- `/api/models` publik: `https://lebrel.ai/api/models`
- Status: `https://lebrel.ai/status`; dashboard: `/dashboard#keys`
### Yang TIDAK gratis (tapi berguna)
| Situs | Isi | Biaya |
|---|---|---|
| openuncensored.com | 61 model uncensored + ranking OU Score | bayar, $10 min |
| molochai.dev | 5 model, API developer | kripto, $10 min |
| tartarusai.dev | uncensored coder + API | kripto, mulai $20 |
| uplinkswitch.ai | **362 model, 68 uncensored**, 1 key | tidak ada kredit gratis |
| abliteration.ai | Abliterated Large v2 (GLM-5.3) | $20/bln; web "try free" |
| redpill.ai | TEE privat, gabung Phala/Tinfoil/NEAR/Chutes | API pay-as-you-go; chat gratis 10 pesan/hari |
| routerhub.si | agregator uncensored/abliterated | - |
| closedhand.com | uncensored personal AI, tanpa perusahaan | - |
### Cloud/SSH baru (hasil sapuan)
- **Hotline Computer** (computer.hotline.dev) — desktop Linux rootless dalam container,
  untuk agen via MCP. **Self-host docker**, bukan kredit cloud.
- **awesome-ai-perks** (github sys2020-sys) — daftar free tier resmi (mayoritas sudah dikenal)
- **bootstrapped-credits** (github aidenixai) — kredit startup TANPA VC:
  AWS $1k-10k, Cloudflare $10k, DO $5k, GCP $3k, OpenAI $1k-2.5k.
  **Butuh perusahaan terdaftar + domain sendiri.**
- Tidak ada VPS/SSH gratis baru yang layak minggu ini.
### Ranking uncensored (OU Score, dari openuncensored)
1. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Uncensored — 69.8 (agentic 55, non-refusal 100, 234 tok/s)
2. GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored — 69.7
3. Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Fast (Heabsy) — 66.8
4. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 Uncensored — 66.1
Catatan: 0% hard-line refusal untuk peringkat 1 dan 3.
'''
t=t.replace("## Catatan keamanan", add.strip()+"\n\n## Catatan keamanan")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY
ok


git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Research: new uncensored providers (Lebrel free \$100/7d), provider map, cloud sweep" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
